text:
dana: Heads up — we're kicking off EU8 account provisioning + network wiring tomorrow morning (09:00 UTC). Need final signoff on CIDR plan, quota requests, and the handoff checklist so SRE/Oncall can validate after infra apply.

nate: Thanks. I put together a quick CIDR plan draft: 10.240.0.0/16 for the region. Split like: management /20 (10.240.0.0/20), shared-services /22 (10.240.16.0/22), gpu-compute /18 (10.240.32.0/18), prod-apps /20 (10.240.128.0/20). Avoid overlapping with eu-central networks.

maya: Looks good. Make sure we reserve at least two /24s inside gpu-compute for node pools (for AZ pinning), and exclude those from autosubnet allocation. Also add a spare /24 for DR.

chen: For security, we'll need NACLs for cross-AZ traffic and explicit subnet routing for GPU instances to go through the NAT gateway in each AZ. Also enable VPC flow logs to a dedicated s3 bucket (retention 90d) — ops requires that for the first 30d of a bring-up.

sabrina: FYI we'll request GPU quota increases before provisioning. Sequence: create cloud account -> billing/tagging -> request GPU quotas -> create VPC/subnets -> provision bastion + VPN/Transit gateway -> confirm peering with shared-services. I can file quota ticket once CIDR is final.

infra-bot: CI job triggered: region-account-template validation started (job-id: 0x9f34). Expect terraform plan artifact in ~8m.

accounts-bot: New cloud account provisioned: redwood-eu8-001. Initial IAM roles created (infra-admin, svc-ops). Please rotate keys and attach SSO groups per onboarding docs: https://internal.redwood/docs/infra/account-onboarding

dana: Great. Two quick asks before we run apply: 1) post the final terraform snippet for the VPC + the subnet allocation so I can review, 2) confirm GPU types available in EU8 (we prefer a mix of A10G + H100 if available).

nate: Terraform snippet below — this is intentionally minimal, policy + tags applied via our terraform modules. Change cidr as needed.

```
resource "aws_vpc" "eu8" {
  cidr_block = "10.240.0.0/16"
  enable_dns_support = true
  enable_dns_hostnames = true
  tags = { Name = "redwood-eu8" }
}

resource "aws_subnet" "gpu_pool_az1" {
  vpc_id = aws_vpc.eu8.id
  cidr_block = "10.240.32.0/20"
  availability_zone = "eu8-az1"
  tags = { Name = "eu8-gpu-az1" }
}
```

maya: That matches our module expectations. Small nit: set map_public_ip_on_launch = false for gpu subnets. Also add `ipv6_enabled = false` explicitly to avoid surprises with account-level defaults.

chen: On quotas, EU8 has H100 backlog in the cloud provider — we'll likely only get A10G immediately. Sabrina, plan for H100 capacity fallback (same image/AMI, diff instance types) and document performance delta in the runbook.

sabrina: Filed quota request: https://provider.console/quotas/request/34567 — asking for 50 A10G and 10 H100. ETA 72h. Tags: project=redwood, env=eu8, owner=infra.

dana: When apply completes, SRE/Oncall will run the validation checklist: basic network reachability, NAT egress, private DNS resolution for shared-services, instance creation in each AZ, kube node join smoke tests, and perf smoke on small GPU instance. I'll paste the checklist after the plan artifact lands.

nate: One more cost note — enabling flow logs + long retention and a shared NAT per AZ increases monthly cost ~~$600/mo for EU8. Flagging finance for the estimate.

maya: Also: configure route table to prefer cross-region replicas for imaging services and ensure our artifact S3 endpoints are VPC endpoint-enabled; avoid public egress for AMI downloads.

dana: Cool. Plan to run apply at 09:15 UTC once infra-bot confirms plan artifact. @sabrina please escalate quota if provider pushes >48h. @nate please finalize CIDR and tag scheme by EOD. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: Terraform plan ready: https://ci.redwood/internal/plans/0x9f34/plan.txt (checks: modules, tag-policy, iam-scan).

chen: I'll shadow the apply and run the post-apply validation. If anything flakes, we'll rollback with the previous network-module state.

sabrina: Noted. I'll post quota updates to this thread and update the handoff checklist in the runbook doc. https://internal.redwood/runbooks/eu-region-provisioning

dana: Thanks all. Closing prep — will DM any blockers.
